text:
anna: Heads up: multiple customers hitting SCIM provisioning failures after the RBAC field push — groups are missing in tenant mappings and some users are being deprovisioned incorrectly. Logs show `403` from provisioner and `KMS decrypt failed: malformed JWE header`. Anyone seeing this? @maria @sam :eyes:

sam: Which provisioner (Okta/AAD) and roughly when did failures start? Any quick logs?

anna: Okta mainly, some AAD. Started ~13:58 UTC after the rollout. Snippet:
```
2026-03-22T13:59:12Z ERROR scim-provisioner tenant=acme err=\"KMS decrypt failed: malformed JWE header\"
http_status=403 path=/scim/v2/Users/386
```

maria: Ops deployed the RBAC change at 13:56, and there was a KMS alias rewrap at 13:50 according to deploy pipeline. @deploy-bot can you confirm the deploys?

deploy-bot: pipeline: scim-provisioner v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0, KMS alias rotate job triggered at 13:50 UTC. All steps reported success.

kevin: If alias rewrap happened without backfilling existing envelopes, decrypt will fail for old envelopes. Can you paste the exact KMS error IDs from the log lines (envelope_id)? That will confirm mismatch. Also check whether we flipped the `KMS_KEY_ALIAS` k8s secret during the deploy.

anna: Pasted envelope lines: `envelope_id=env_0x9f7a3 trunc_id=0x3b2` — DB shows envs stored with aliases that don't match the new alias. I also noticed the SCIM preprocessor concatenates RBAC role onto `displayName` for matching; that might have caused mismatches (truncation) leading to deprovision triggers.

sam: Two parallel issues then — bad decrypts + name normalization mismatch. We changed the Nginx ingress `client_max_body_size` and `proxy_buffer_size` last week; large SAML assertions could have been clipped, causing NameID changes. Can you confirm assertion sizes in the audit logs?

maria: Quick mitigation steps we can do now: 1) enable fallback key resolver (allow decrypt with old alias), 2) requeue failed SCIM events for reprocessing, 3) pause any aggressive auto-deprovision jobs until the backfill finishes. I can flip the fallback flag if we agree.

anna: Agreed — please flip fallback. I've paused deprovision worker. Requeued ~270 failed events to the retry queue. Monitoring for duplicate user ops.

kevin: Long-term fix: run a one-off backfill job to rewrap existing envelopes with the new alias (safe path), add a pre-rotation smoke test that decrypts a sample batch, and add an audit alert that fires when decrypt error rate > 0.5% post-rotate. Also add an integration test for SAML->SCIM name concatenation edge cases.

maria: I will open a JIRA (SEC-8672) with action items: backfill job owner (infra), SCIM patch (idp team), ingress buffer revert or SAML chunk support (platform). Also drafting customer comms for affected tenants. @sam can you export the impacted org list from the audit sink? :writing_hand:

sam: On it — pulling audit-log-sink now, will post list to #customer-success in ~15m.

anna: Thanks. For transparency: added `incident` label and linking to current SLO page. Will update thread when backfill completes or if we need to escalate to on-call pager.

ops-bot: Alert acknowledged. Pager duty: maria (on-call) assigned.

maria: Follow-ups: (1) enable fallback (done), (2) run decrypt backfill in dry-run to verify counts, (3) schedule maintenance window for full rewrap. I'll update SEC-8672 with timelines.

anna: Good. Keep this thread for timeline updates. If anyone sees repeated `malformed JWE header` entries after fallback, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
